# API Changelog

All notable API changes produced by AI workflows are documented here.
Each entry corresponds to a Jira issue and merge request.

## Format

Each entry follows this structure:

```
## [{JIRA_ISSUE_KEY}] — {DATE}

### Added
- `POST /api/resource` — Description

### Changed
- `GET /api/resource/{id}` — Description of change

### Deprecated
- `GET /api/old-endpoint` — Use `/api/new-endpoint` instead

### Removed
- `DELETE /api/legacy` — Removed in this release
```
